purpose: Consolidated research-validation portfolio state for IRFEN v0.8 and Phase-2 preparation. This artifact does not alter the three-pilot v0.8 operational scope, release scorecard, thresholds, alerts or production logic.

v08_scope.operational_baseline: v0.7.1 remains unchanged until explicit promotion

portfolio_summary.note: Case-level research closure is distinct from zone-contract approval or operational activation.

cases.scope: Historical/research validation case; production remains blocked.
cases.primary_limitation: Current hydraulic response after recent works still requires validation before production consideration.

cases.scope: Historical research validation of rainfall, river-flow and flood-impact behavior.
cases.primary_limitation: No confirmed negative control; current channel/floodplain capacity and primary numeric river-state automation remain production gates.

cases.scope: 2023 Malanche event research baseline based on SENAMHI report and reproducible references.
cases.primary_limitation: Event discharge is modelled reconstruction, not observed gauge truth; raw terrain/model products are unavailable to IRFEN.

cases.scope: Bounded historical validation of the 2017 Lurin river flood sequence.
cases.primary_limitation: No confirmed negative control and no validated event-specific hydraulic transfer from Antapucro to downstream impact reaches.

cases.scope: Cashahuacra local debris-flow positive component only.
cases.primary_limitation: Does not resolve Santa Eulalia river state, Rimac receiving capacity or compound synchronization; candidate DEM catchment is not an official watershed boundary.

cases.scope: Bounded historical positive-outcome validation of recurrent Rio Mala overflow behavior from 2017 through 2025.
cases.primary_limitation: No confirmed negative control or event-paired La Capilla flow for the historical outcomes; station observations are not transferred to impact reaches and tributary debris-flow mechanisms remain unresolved.

cases.scope: Bounded positive-outcome validation for Cuenca Zaña / Oyotún using official 2008 and 2009 historical evidence plus official ANA hydrologic-unit geometry.
cases.primary_limitation: No event-day rainfall/discharge or confirmed negative control; Nanchoc-to-Zaña routing, tributary activation and current channel capacity remain unresolved.

cases.scope: Bounded historical positive-outcome validation for recurrent Rio La Leche flooding in Pacora and Pitipo.
cases.primary_limitation: No confirmed negative control, no event-paired primary rainfall/discharge series, no normalized machine-readable basin geometry, and Rio Motupe/local-ravine/current-capacity components remain unresolved.

cases.scope: Bounded historical positive-outcome validation for Chongoyape within Cuenca Chancay-Lambayeque, with Rio Chancay, Rio Yaipon and local quebradas kept mechanism-separated.
cases.primary_limitation: No confirmed negative control or event-paired primary rainfall/discharge series; cross-component routing and current channel capacity remain unvalidated, and source-reported 2025 flows are context only.
Clean-room control adjudication and safe-unblind are incomplete; outcome-bearing INGEMMET evidence remains sealed from matching and reranking.

system_level_open_items.rule: A closed local component cannot promote the compound system contract.
Historical case closeout does not activate the Phase-2 zone contract.
A bounded historical positive closeout does not approve the Phase-2 zone contract or authorize station-to-reach transfer.
A bounded historical case closeout does not approve the hydrologic child contract; the official whole-basin geometry cannot substitute for event-specific routing evidence.
The bounded La Leche historical closeout does not approve the compound Motupe-La Leche-Pitipo contract or authorize current hydraulic assumptions.
The bounded Chongoyape historical closeout does not approve the hydrologic child contract; Rio Chancay, Rio Yaipon and local quebradas remain distinct components without validated cross-routing.
Do not use sealed outcome evidence before safe-unblind.
